item.description:

LHASA, Oct. 30 -- The temperature in the earthquake-hit area of Nagqu City, south west China's Xizang Autonomous Region, will drop soon. Troops assigned to the Chinese People's Armed Police Force (PAP) Nagqu detachment are working against time to help the affected residents move into warm-keeping prefabricated houses, ensuring they can safely get through the winter.

item.title: CPC plenum concludes, adopting resolution on persevering with full, rigorous Party self-governance
item.description:
Published: 2026-10-29
Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, delivers an important address at the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee in Beijing, capital of China. The 20th CPC Central Committee held its fifth plenary session in Beijing from Oct. 26 to Oct. 29, 2026. (Xinhua/Xie Huanchi) BEIJING, Oct. 29 (Xinhua) -- The 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) held its fifth plenary session from Monday to Thursday in Beijing, adopting a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance. The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee presided over the meeting. Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, delivered an important address, said a communique issued after the session. At the session, participants heard and discussed a report on the work of the Political Bureau presented by Xi. They also considered and adopted the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance. Xi delivered explanatory remarks on the draft of the resolution. The CPC Central Committee fully affirmed the work of the Political Bureau since the committee's fourth plenary session, the communique said. Looking back on the Party's journey since its founding, the CPC Central Committee pointed out that the key to the success of the CPC in winning one victory after another lies in its pursuit of the high ideal of communism, its dedication to achieving lasting greatness for the Chinese nation, and its commitment to seeking happiness for the Chinese people and rejuvenation for the Chinese nation. At the session, the CPC Central Committee gave a highly positive assessment of the great achievements the Party has made in exercising full and rigorous self-governance in the new era. It was pointed out that as the Party endeavors to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen itself in the new era, the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has put forward a series of new ideas, new thinking, and new strategies in response to the major questions of the times -- what kind of long-term governing Marxist party the CPC should build and how to build it, thereby giving rise to Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building. "It was stressed that many favorable conditions are now in place for advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance, while we also face many new circumstances and new issues in this endeavor," the communique said. Profound changes in global, national, and Party conditions have made the CPC's tasks of uniting and leading the people in safeguarding China's sovereignty, security, and development interests, of uniting and leading the people in promoting reform and development and maintaining social harmony and stability, and of maintaining its advanced nature and integrity even more formidable, it added. "Dedicated to fulfilling the Party's missions and tasks, we must act in line with the overall requirements for Party building in the new era, take the Party Constitution as our fundamental guide, maintain the Party's vanguard nature, and uphold the overall leadership of the Party and the centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee," the communique said. At the session, the guiding principles for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance were highlighted as follows: serving the Party's missions and tasks; taking strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle; exercising rigorous governance across the board; adopting a problem-oriented approach; upholding fundamental principles and breaking new ground; adhering to a top-down approach; and running the Party according to regulations. Systematic plans for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance were also made at the session, according to the communique. Strengthening the Party spirit represents a fundamental task in the CPC's efforts to ensure full and rigorous Party self-governance, it said. Democratic centralism is the Party's fundamental organizational principle and leadership system, and its implementation is therefore an inherent requirement for exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, the communique added. Strict management of officials is the key to full and rigorous Party self-governance, it noted. "We will build up the ranks of high-caliber officials with firm political commitment, outstanding professional competence, excellent work conduct, and strict discipline," it added. Party organizations at all levels play the principal role in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, said the communique, adding that it is therefore essential to systematically advance the development of Party organizations at all levels and in all sectors to strengthen their political and organizational functions. Improving conduct and tightening discipline are effective measures to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance, said the communique. "It was noted that taking integrated steps to ensure that officials do not have the audacity, opportunity, or desire to commit corruption is both an important strategy for full and rigorous Party self-governance and a fundamental guideline for our fight against corruption," the communique said. "We must take systematic steps to address both symptoms and root causes of corruption and adopt a holistic approach that combines severe punishment, targeted remedy, and effective prevention, carrying this fight through to the end," it stated. Strengthening Party regulations and institutions represents a long-term, fundamental strategy for ensuring full and rigorous Party self-governance, said the communique. Persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance entails further improvement to Party and state oversight systems, said the communique, adding that it is the common political responsibility of all Party members. Studying and implementing the guiding principles from this plenary session represent a major political task for the entire Party both at present and in the period to come, according to the communique. It was also stressed that all aspects of the Party's work agenda should be steadily advanced at the turn of the year. The CPC Central Committee decided at the session that the Party will convene its 21st National Congress in Beijing in the second half of 2027 and stated that this congress, which is to be held at a critical stage for basically realizing socialist modernization and on a new journey toward the Second Centenary Goal, will be a highly important meeting and an event of great political significance for both the Party and the country. The session elected Zhang Shengmin as a new member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, according to the communique. The session also decided on the filling of empty seats on the Central Committee by alternate members, deliberated and adopted inspection reports of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Central Military Commission on those committing grave violations of discipline and laws, and confirmed the Political Bureau's previous decisions to punish those violators. The CPC Central Committee called upon the entire Party to rally more closely around the CPC Central Committee with Xi at its core and fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. item.title: The Philippines Abuses Chairmanship to Put up Obstacles to China's Participation in ADMM-Plus: Defense Spokesperson
item.description:
Published: 2026-10-29
BEIJING, Oct.29 -- "The Philippine side's willful acts to hijack ASEAN and stir up troubles would only undermine the credibility of ADMM-Plus, erode solidarity and mutual trust among ASEAN countries, and ultimately, impair the fundamental interests of the countries and peoples in the region, including the Philippines," said Senior Colonel Zhang Xiaogang, spokesperson for China's defense ministry, at a regular press conference on Thursday. The spokesperson made the remarks while responding to media question about the absence of China's defense minister from this year's ADMM-Plus meeting in the Philippines. The spokesperson first confirmed that the ADMM-Plus is the highest-level and largest defense and security dialogue and cooperation mechanism in the Asia-Pacific. Established in 2010, it has served as an important platform for countries to build trust, strengthen cooperation, and uphold regional peace and stability. He then pointed out that as the rotating chair of this year's ADMM-Plus, the Philippine side has allowed a certain self-serving politician to act recklessly and abuse its chairmanship to put up obstacles to China's participation. The spokesperson seriously criticized such moves of the Philippine side, stating that they seriously violate ASEAN's principle of consensus through consultation and run counter to the open and inclusive spirit of the ADMM-Plus. "They do not conform to basic diplomatic protocols, and undermine China's legitimate rights as a member of the mechanism. Many ASEAN countries have raised questions and opposition over this," said the spokesperson. "Against such a backdrop, the Chinese side still decided to send representatives to attend the meeting, which demonstrates China's firm support to ASEAN centrality and responsible attitude towards regional defense and security cooperation," added the spokesperson.

item.title: Int’l community should stay on high alert against tricks played by Japan's right-wing forces: Defense Spokesperson
item.description:
Published: 2026-10-29
BEIJING, Oct. 29 -- "Anyone familiar with history knows that manipulating public opinion first, fabricating excuses next and taking actions in the end is an old trick of Japanese militarists to launch aggression in the past," said Senior Colonel Zhang Xiaogang, spokesperson for China's Ministry of National Defense (MND), at a press conference on October 29, 2026. According to media reports, China’s PLANS Liaoning Carrier Task Group recently conducted far-seas training in the Western Pacific. The Japanese Self-Defense Force vessels and aircraft tracked and monitored the Chinese carrier task group, while some Japanese defense officials claimed that Japan's monitoring capabilities are limited and Japan needs to further strengthen its "defense posture". In response to the above reports, the spokesperson pointed out that the training of the PLANS Liaoning Carrier Task Group (CTG Liaoning) in relevant waters of the Western Pacific is a routine arrangement within the annual plan of the Chinese military. It aims to test and improve the combat capabilities of the CTG in the far seas, does not target any specific country or objective, and is in compliance with international law and international practices. "Many netizens refer to the Japanese side as a 'chief photographer' of the Chinese PLA Navy. These 'chief photographers' often spy on China's normal training and exercises, exaggerate the situation, deceive the Japanese public, mislead international public opinion, and make up excuses for Japan’s military expansion and reinforcement," added the spokesperson. "The international community should stay on high alert against such tricks played by Japan's right-wing forces, and resolutely curb the reckless moves of Japan's neo-militarism," stressed the spokesperson.

item.title: China confirms identities of 8 more CPV martyrs from War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea
item.description:
Published: 2026-10-28
BEIJING, Oct. 28 (Xinhua) -- China has confirmed the identities of eight more Chinese People's Volunteers (CPV) martyrs who lost their lives during the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea (1950-1953), the Ministry of Veterans Affairs said on Wednesday. The eight martyrs were identified as Shi Zhicheng, Xia Xiaolong, Zhang Zhenfa, Ren Dianyi, Jiao Dezheng, Xia Zongzhi, Chen Zhiguo and Zhang Changxing. This marks further progress in efforts to identify the remains of CPV martyrs repatriated from the Republic of Korea (ROK), the ministry said. More than 70 years ago, the CPV crossed the Yalu River and fought alongside the army and civilians of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK) against the ROK army and U.S.-led UN forces. China sent 2.9 million CPV soldiers to assist the DPRK during the war, of whom more than 360,000 were killed or injured. Most of the fallen CPV soldiers were buried on the Korean Peninsula. According to an agreement between China and the ROK signed in late 2013, the two sides consult every year on the handover of remains of Chinese soldiers found in the ROK. Since 2014, China and the ROK have completed 13 consecutive handovers involving the remains of 1,023 CPV martyrs. In recent years, China has intensified efforts to identify the remains of CPV martyrs, including the creation of a DNA database for martyrs and their relatives, offering solid technical and data support to help more families find their missing loved ones. To date, the identities of 44 of the martyrs have been confirmed and their relatives have been located.
